definitions.short: a dromedary (from its rapid motion as if dancing)
definitions.full: H3753. kirkarah [ כִּרְכָּרָה ] noun feminine dromedary (according to Ki Thes; perhaps from constantly repeated undulating movement); — only plural absolute וּבַכִּרְכָּרוֺת Isa 66:20 (+ וּבַמְּרָדִים וּבַצַּבִּים וּבָרֶכֶב בַּסּוּסִים ; the whole list is a gloss according to Du Che Intr Is .).
